topic.title: Brownfield Land Registers / Permission in Principle
topic.source_contract: register status, site boundary, previously developed land criteria, suitability, availability, achievability, Part 1/Part 2 status, consultation, permission in principle, technical details consent and delivery evidence

scope_guards: A Part 1 register entry is not treated as permission in principle.
A Part 2 entry is not treated as technical details consent.
Previously developed land status is not treated as suitability for every use.
An estimated capacity is not treated as an approved dwelling count.
Availability evidence is not treated as secured land control.
A consultation notice is not treated as a final decision.
Permission in principle is not treated as construction commencement.
No score or promotion is written without exact register, consent, land-control, construction and completion evidence.
